sources.title: Current Accounts | Find the Right Current Account for You
Monzo Help - Understanding fees for using your Monzo card abroad

brands.evidence: I’d pick Monzo’s free current account if you want an app-based bank for your salary, bills and everyday spending.
I’d choose Starling instead if you regularly take out cash outside the UK and European Economic Area.

client_claims.text: You also get spending categories and alerts without paying a monthly fee.
client_claims.note: Free plan exists per facts, but spending categories and alerts are not covered.

client_claims.text: Both banks let you pay by card abroad without charging a foreign transaction fee.
client_claims.note: Monzo charges no fee on card spending abroad.

client_claims.text: Free Monzo charges 3% after the first £200 withdrawn in a rolling 30-day period outside the EEA.
client_claims.note: Matches £200 every 30 days outside the EEA with a 3% fee after.

client_claims.text: Salary Sorter lets you set aside money for rent and bills in separate Pots on payday.
client_claims.note: Salary Sorter is not covered by the facts.
